messages.subject: NIMBIoS Online Tutorial: Using R for high-performance computing
parts:
Hi all,

National Institute for Mathematical and Biological Synthesis (NIMBioS) is running a four-hour tutorial on using R for high performance computing 10-12 on Feb 27, which will be live-streamed.

Topics include debugging, profiling and performance analysis, optimization, calling code in other languages, and parallel programming with R.  

For more info and to register (by Feb 25), go here: http://www.nimbios.org/tutorials/TT_RforHPC
